title: Prompt cache and context checkpoints of hybrid (Gated DeltaNet) Qwen models
setup: Temporary router with copies of the production section; one slot (--parallel 1). Scenario: a simulated agent chat of 36-68 steps in which every request carries the whole history, then one short foreign request (like the title request of a new chat) that takes the only slot, then a return to the original chat plus one step. 'Return time' is the wall-clock time of that last request. The 'compaction summary' request imitates the one sent by an agent harness: same system prompt and same messages up to 78% of the chat plus a final instruction; only prompt processing is measured.

rows.note: no checkpoint behind the summary prefix: full re-processing at ~400 tok/s

qwen36_compaction_summary_request.why: Checkpoints are kept at least 8192 tokens apart and only the N most recent survive. The summary prefix ends ~37,000 tokens before the end of the chat (~4.5 spacings): with 8 checkpoints there is always one behind it; with 4 there is none.

rows.outcome: prompt state 7230 MiB exceeds the 4096 MiB cache limit: skipped
rows.note: the first attempt was cut by a 300 s client timeout; at 150-225 tok/s a full re-processing is 5-7 min

qwen38_return_to_chat.state_growth: about 39 MiB per 1,000 tokens: ~4.5 GiB at 85,000 tokens, ~6.4 GiB at 131,000 and ~11.5 GiB at 262,144 (with 8 checkpoints)
